description: This file contains a SCSS mixin library for responsive font sizes, paddings, margins, and other properties using the RFS (Responsive Font Sizes) approach. It includes configurations, functions, and mixins to generate scalable, responsive CSS values based on screen size and other parameters.

methods.name: divide
methods.description: Performs precise division of two numbers with specified precision, handling units and sign, used internally for calculations.

methods.name: rfs-value
methods.description: Calculates the CSS value(s) for non-responsive properties, converting units if necessary.

methods.name: rfs-fluid-value
methods.description: Calculates the responsive, fluid value(s) for properties based on screen dimensions and breakpoints.
